# Third-party notices

<!-- Generated by scripts/third-party-notices.mjs (pnpm notices). Do not edit by hand. -->

Market Pulse's frontend distributes the components below to the browser (in the client
JavaScript bundle, or as self-hosted font files). For each, the license its package declares
and the license and notice texts it publishes are reproduced exactly. This document records
those texts; it is not a legal opinion.

Charts are rendered with TradingView Lightweight Charts™ (https://www.tradingview.com/).

| Component | Version | Declared license | Use |
|---|---|---|---|
| lightweight-charts | 5.2.1 | Apache-2.0 | Historical charts (client bundle). |
| fancy-canvas | 2.1.0 | MIT | Canvas helper used by Lightweight Charts (client bundle). |
| next | 16.4.3 | MIT | Application framework; its client runtime is in the client bundle. |
| react | 19.3.0 | MIT | UI library (client bundle). |
| react-dom | 19.3.0 | MIT | UI library (client bundle). |
| scheduler | 0.28.0 | MIT | React scheduler (client bundle). |
| @swc/helpers | 0.5.23 | Apache-2.0 | Compiler runtime helpers Next.js can include in client code (listed as a precaution: its presence in the minified client bundle could not be confirmed). |
| Geist and Geist Mono (fonts) | as served by Google Fonts at build time | OFL-1.1 | Interface fonts, downloaded by next/font/google at build time and served from this application. |

Optional dependencies of which each machine installs only the variant for its operating
system and CPU. Every variant in the lockfile is listed; the declared license of each family
is checked against the installed variants whenever these notices are generated or checked.
sharp and its binaries are used only by Next.js image optimization (next/image), which this application does not use; they are not distributed to the browser.
